hero.title:
Tapas to share,
cooked like home.
hero.lede: A neighbourhood restaurant in Les Roquetes where the cooking still takes its time: croquettes that are their specialty, bravas with a sauce of their own, a slow-cooked cazuela of the day and a wonderfully aromatic vermouth. No rush, and an owner who keeps an eye on every table.

about.title:
A neighbourhood spot
you end up loving.
about.p1: Entre Tapas sits on Carrer de Roger de Flor in Les Roquetes, the part of Sant Pere de Ribes that faces the Garraf coast. It is a small, unpretentious restaurant with tables made for sharing and a kitchen that smells of stock from first thing in the morning.
about.p2: People come here to eat well without ceremony: familiar dishes, honest produce and portions meant for the middle of the table. If it is your first time, ask about the croquettes and the cazuela of the day; if you are already a regular, you know why you keep coming back.
about.note: Home-style tapas, to eat in, take away or have delivered.

kitchen.title: What comes out of the kitchen
kitchen.lede: A short menu that moves with what is available. These are the dishes that keep turning up in the reviews — almost always for the same reason.
